## Self-Review Against the Eight Gates

- [ ] Scope: the diff contains only what the authorising artefact permits.
- [ ] Authority: no protected document changed, or an accepted AIP is linked and the lock is regenerated.
- [ ] Architecture: nothing beyond Architecture Baseline AB-1.0 is described.
- [ ] Quality: no drafting markers, empty files, duplicated definitions or unverifiable claims.
- [ ] Verification: `make validate` and `make test` pass.
- [ ] Documentation: every new or changed document meets the Documentation Standard.
- [ ] Traceability: decisions, risks and engineering memory are updated.
- [ ] Human review: a human maintainer is requested; the author has not approved or merged.
